module: Manager of the vehicle's energy tanks (fuel, battery, N2O, compressed air...). At init it dynamically loads each type from lua/vehicle/energyStorage/<type>.lua for each entry of the jbeam `energyStorage` section, registers the storages with the powertrain devices (device.energyStorage), updates `remainingRatio` every frame and relays beam break, coupling and part condition events. A modder uses it to find a storage by name (getStorage/getStorageSafe) and read/modify its stored energy.
usage:
local tank = energyStorage.getStorage("mainTank")
if tank then
  print(tank.storedEnergy, tank.remainingRatio)
end
-- call safe from errors: returns a fake object if the name does not exist
energyStorage.getStorageSafe("nope"):setRemainingVolume(0)
notes: Each storage is created by `<factory>.new(jbeamData)` with jbeamData = the jbeam entry merged with the jbeam section of the same name (v.data[name]). The `type` field chooses the file (electricBattery, fuelTank, n2oTank, pressureTank, or any .lua in the energyStorage folder).
An unknown type causes an error log and an immediate `return` from init: the following storages and the device wiring are then not initialized.

Each storage exposes at least name, storedEnergy, initialStoredEnergy and remainingRatio (recomputed here every frame = storedEnergy / initialStoredEnergy, or 0 if the initial energy is 0). Recognized optional methods: updateGFX, reset, onBreak, onCouplerFound, onCouplerAttached, onCouplerDetached, setPartCondition, getPartCondition, serialize.
breakTriggerBeam (beam name or list of names): when one of them breaks, beamBroke calls storage:onBreak() and sets damageTracker('energyStorage', name) to true.
M.updateGFX is nop as long as no storage exists; init replaces it with the real function only if storageCount > 0.
onDeserialize is empty (the restore code is commented out): the state serialized by onSerialize is not read back.
onCouplerAttached receives attachSpeed but does not pass it to the storages (they receive nodeId, obj2id, obj2nodeId, attachEnergy).
getPartCondition never provides a visual condition (canProvideVisualCondition stays false).

nilStorage.desc: 'Magic' fake storage created in init: any indexing or call returns itself, writes are ignored. Returned by getStorageSafe when the name does not exist. Is {} (without a metatable) before the first init.

updateGFX.desc: Is nop (global variable nop) as long as there is no storage; replaced in init by the per-frame update function. (The extraction .md flags nop as undefined: it is an engine global.)

init.desc: Called at vehicle initialization: discovers the available types, instantiates the jbeam storages, registers them in the powertrain devices, builds the table of beams that trigger a break and creates nilStorage.

reset.desc: Called at vehicle reset: calls reset() of each storage, sets their damage back to false in damageTracker and re-registers the storages with the devices.

beamBroke.desc: Called by the engine when a beam breaks. If the beam is a trigger of a storage, calls storage:onBreak() and sets the damage in damageTracker.

onCouplerFound.desc: Hook called when a coupler finds a nearby partner; relayed to storage:onCouplerFound.

onCouplerAttached.desc: Hook called when a coupler attaches; relayed to storage:onCouplerAttached without attachSpeed.

onCouplerDetached.desc: Hook called when a coupler detaches; relayed to storage:onCouplerDetached.

getStorages.desc: Returns the table of all storages keyed by name.

getStorage.desc: Returns the storage with this name, or nil if it does not exist.

getStorageSafe.desc: Like getStorage but returns nilStorage (object that absorbs all accesses and calls) if the name is unknown, with a debug log.

getPartCondition.desc: Aggregates the integrity condition of the storages linked to the part ('energyStorage:<name>' types). integrityValue is the minimum of the storage values, integrityState a table by name.

returns.desc: true if at least one storage can provide an integrity condition.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies the part condition (odometer, integrity, visual) to the storages linked to the part; if integrity is a table with the key energyStorage, the storage value is taken by its name.

onDeserialize.desc: Deserialization (save) hook; currently without effect (code commented out).

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook: returns {name = storage:serialize()} for the storages that have serialize().
